title: Backend Developer
description:
Design, build and run the Python services behind our products.
Responsibilities: build REST APIs, model data in PostgreSQL, write efficient SQL, containerise services, deploy to AWS, add caching, write tests.
Required skills: Python, FastAPI, Django, SQL, PostgreSQL, REST APIs, Docker, AWS, Git, Redis.
Experience: 2+ years in a similar role.

title: Frontend Developer
description:
Build fast, accessible web interfaces with React and TypeScript.
Responsibilities: build React components, manage application state, integrate REST APIs, write responsive layouts, test components, review pull requests.
Required skills: JavaScript, TypeScript, React, HTML, CSS, Redux, REST APIs, Git, Jest, Accessibility.
Experience: 1+ years in a similar role.

title: Data Analyst
description:
Turn business data into clear decisions for every team.
Responsibilities: write SQL queries, clean and analyse data, build dashboards, run statistical analysis, present insights to stakeholders.
Required skills: SQL, Excel, Python, Pandas, Power BI, Tableau, Statistics, Data Visualization, Dashboards.
Experience: 1+ years in a similar role.

title: Machine Learning Engineer
description:
Build, ship and monitor production machine learning systems.
Responsibilities: train and evaluate models, work on NLP and computer vision problems, build data pipelines, deploy and monitor models.
Required skills: Python, Machine Learning, Deep Learning, PyTorch, TensorFlow, Scikit-learn, NLP, Computer Vision, MLOps, SQL.
Experience: 2+ years in a similar role.

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
Run reliable, secure and cost-efficient cloud infrastructure.
Responsibilities: manage AWS with infrastructure as code, run containers on Kubernetes, build CI/CD pipelines, automate operations, own monitoring and incident response.
Required skills: AWS, Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, CI/CD, Linux, Bash, Monitoring, Python, Git.
Experience: 2+ years in a similar role.

title: QA Automation Engineer
description:
Protect product quality with automated testing.
Responsibilities: design test plans, automate UI and API tests, validate data, run tests in CI/CD, track defects in Agile teams.
Required skills: Selenium, Python, Java, Test Automation, API Testing, Postman, SQL, CI/CD, Jira, Agile.

title: HR Executive

Support recruitment and day-to-day people operations.

Connect business goals with product delivery.
